### Added
- **Context files in the system prompt** (#53, added in #61 and #73). pi-action puts the repository's context files into the system prompt, as pi does: `AGENTS.override.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.MD`, `CLAUDE.md`, or `CLAUDE.MD`, from the workspace root down to the working directory, and from `agent_dir`. This is on by default. To turn it off, set `context_files: false`. `context_files_max_bytes` limits the size. On pull requests from forks, the files come from the base commit. See [Context files](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.5.0/docs/prompts.md#context-files).
- **Skills** (#54, added in #62). pi-action loads [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) (`SKILL.md`) as pi does: from the packages in `extensions` and in the new `skills` input, from `.pi/skills/` and `.agents/skills/` with `trust_project: true`, and from `agent_dir`. The system prompt lists the skills, and `/skill:<name>` in a request uses a skill explicitly. The code of the packages in `skills` does not run. See [Skills](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.5.0/docs/skills.md).
- **pi's base system prompt** (#65, added in #70). The system prompt now has pi's sections: what the model is, the tools it gets, pi's rules, and the working directory. Before, the model got none of these. See [The system prompt](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.5.0/docs/prompts.md#the-system-prompt).
- **`SYSTEM.md` and `APPEND_SYSTEM.md`** (#67, added in #72). `SYSTEM.md` replaces pi's base sections, and `APPEND_SYSTEM.md` adds text after them, as in pi. pi-action reads them from `.pi/` with `trust_project: true` (not on pull requests from forks), else from `agent_dir`. To turn them off, set `system_prompt_files: false`. See [System prompt files](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.5.0/docs/prompts.md#system-prompt-files).
- **Images for pi-durable extensions** (#55, added in #71). pi-durable extensions get an image processor in their host options (`images`). With it, pit's `workspace.viewImage` can resize images that are too large, instead of rejecting them. See [Host options](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.5.0/docs/extensions.md#host-options).

### Changed
- **Runs think at pi's default level, medium** (#66, added in #74). pi-action now sets a thinking level on every run, with the new `thinking_level` input (`off`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`). Before, every run was `off`. Runs on models with reasoning can now use more tokens and time. To keep the old behavior, set `thinking_level: off`. Models without reasoning support get `off`, with a log line. See [Thinking](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.5.0/docs/models.md#thinking).
- **Existing threads get the new system prompt.** On their next run, threads that started before this release get one system prompt update for the new sections. This causes one miss of the prompt cache.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cv/pi-action/compare/v2.4.0...v2.5.0
